text: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed the CopilotKit packages, and created all required files exactly per the quickstart (`.env`, `route.ts`, `providers.tsx`, updated `layout.tsx` and `page.tsx`). TypeScript type-checking passed cleanly (`npx tsc --noEmit` exited 0). The dev server started and reported "Ready in 239ms" on `http://localhost:3000`. However, the compilation got stuck at `○ Compiling / ...` indefinitely and never served a response; the production build was also killed (exit 137, likely OOM). Without a valid `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the environment and with the compilation hanging, I could not verify a working copilot endpoint. The deviation from docs was using a placeholder API key since none was exported in the sandbox, and disabling Turbopack to reduce memory pressure.
